title: gh release list --limit ${forge_list_limit} --json tagName,name,isPrerelease,isDraft,isLatest,publishedAt,createdAt
description: The releases, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:releases) and folds in `modules/jq/forge.jq` (forge::github_releases). The types are the Release object of GitHub's GraphQL schema, https://docs.github.com/public/fpt/schema.docs.graphql, as gh renders its fields (https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/trunk/pkg/cmd/release/list/http.go): a null name as "", and a draft's null publishedAt as 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z.
